description: The cross-language message parity is asserted in both engines' docstrings and was true only for ASCII. json.dumps defaults to ensure_ascii=True and escapes every non-ASCII code point; JSON.stringify does not. Every fixture that could have caught it was ASCII, so the parity claim was vacuous in exactly this dimension. This fixture carries a member name with a Latin-1 accent and an astral emoji, and BOTH engines assert the same expected_message_contains against it.
expected_message_contains: x-datacompany-hash-declaration-only at ["/café😀"] is not strictly inside
